description: This Java source file defines an Android Fragment class named LogFragment, which manages a view displaying log data through a custom LogView component. It handles view creation, styling, and ensuring the log scrolls to the bottom when new text is added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that manages a logging view within a scrollable layout, enabling real-time display and automatic scrolling of log messages.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets styling parameters, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log data, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
